message: Model source registry: clients can contribute bring-your-own-key model sources to the host through `RootState.modelSourceRegistrations` and the client-dispatchable `root/modelSourceRegistrationSet`, `root/modelSourceContributorRemoved`, and `root/modelSourceRegistrationRemoved` actions. Several clients can contribute one registration, listed in `contributingClientIds`, and a client that joins an unchanged definition keeps its status and credential. Clients deliver each source's credential with a `modelSource` `authenticate` target that echoes the registration's host-issued `credentialNonce` and names the key with a non-secret `credentialId`. The host reports status, `credentialResource`, `credentialOrigins`, and `credentialId` with the host-only `root/modelSourceStateChanged` action, using model-source-specific auth reasons (`required`, `expired`, `rejected`, `revoked`), and ends turns on an unavailable source with the resumable `modelSourceUnavailable` error. Agents advertise the definition formats they read, the contributor grace period, and the principal policy with `AgentCapabilities.modelSourceRegistration`.
